newsitem.title: UK: 'Unbundling' to hit small channels - BSkyB.
newsitem.headline: 'Unbundling' to hit small channels - BSkyB.

text.p: Any moves to prevent BSkyB Plc from selling television channels in packages or bundles could spell the end for some small channels, BSkyB chief executive Sam Chisholm said on Friday.

The Independent Television Commission (ITC), the UK TV watchdog, is reviewing how BSkyB sells its channels after complaints from cable operators. The cable companies want greater freedom to pick and choose individual channels.
"I think the ITC will think very carefully about bundling," Chisholm told a news conference. "If they do unbundle it's the little guy that gets hurt," he added.
"It would be a shame to see small channels disappear and unbundling would do that," he added.
